prompt.intro: You are shown two screenshots of a browser 3D racing game, labelled Image A and Image B. Both are taken at the same moment of the same recorded run (same road position, same speed), with the on-screen HUD hidden. Exactly one of them is from the original, shipped game; the other is from an independent re-implementation that tries to reproduce it. Judge only what is visible in the 3D scene: sky, road, scenery, lighting, glow, the vehicles and the camera.
prompt.question: Answer with one JSON object and nothing else, with these keys: "same_game": true if a player would take both for the same game with the same art direction, false otherwise; "same_game_confidence": a number from 0 to 1; "original": "A" or "B", whichever you believe is the original shipped game (you must choose one); "original_confidence": a number from 0.5 to 1; "tells": up to three short phrases naming the visible differences that drove your choice.
